claims.claim: Best adapted small model recovers 89.7% at 4% cost
claims.qualification: Best case in seven business tasks and three small-model families; 16/21 pairs improved and seven closed the gap. Not an all-task guarantee or our cost result.
Four Theory-of-Mind benchmarks; 5% validation for iterative construction. These are scores, not speed multipliers or Gaussian/coding measurements.

claims.claim: Three iterations yield about +52% average and +83% maximum
claims.qualification: Abstract says relative 52.25% average and 82.86% maximum over specified harness-model pairs on GameCraft-Bench, FrontierSWE and ProgramBench. Not percentage-point gains.

claims.claim: Weng essay and harness design patterns
claims.qualification: July 4, 2026 essay; selected patterns and evaluator limits reviewed, not every cited paper.
Article authored by Birgitta Böckeler, hosted on Martin Fowler site, dated April 2, 2026.

claims.claim: Thoughtworks retreat proves smaller model beats larger model
claims.qualification: Located discussion that harness attention can make weaker models useful. The exact broad competitive claim lacks a matched comparison in the passages inspected.

claims.claim: Rethinking Harnesses and its exact keep-sensors argument
claims.qualification: Official index establishes title/date September 12. Detailed video argument remains supplied framing, not independently transcribed here.
No canonical post/text established. Preserve user-supplied attribution without invented quote or link.

claims.claim: Plasma Radio is already connected for this team
claims.qualification: Official located product calls its channel Fractal Radio. Exact intended installation, endpoints, principals and pickup/receipt coverage remain unknown.

claims.claim: Two failures implies a new rule; sensors passing implies done
claims.qualification: Recommendations below separate offline iteration, consequential attempts, independent acceptance and rule review. No old allowance changes.

claims.claim: Checkable output plus failure memory implies exponential improvement
claims.qualification: These support measurement but do not establish any growth rate. End-to-end gain remains null.
